usage.useWhen: Comparing two to four products of the own WooCommerce shop side by side, with live prices, rating, chosen attributes, availability and an add to cart link.
usage.avoidWhen: Plans, services or anything that is not a WooCommerce product, or figures that must not change with the shop; use the comparison table. Not available without WooCommerce.
usage.a11y: Give the table a caption that names what is compared. Each add to cart link names its product; the highlighted column is bold, so do not rely on the highlight alone to say which product you recommend.
